Weather Clothes

You fasten the heavy outer layer against the weather.

Rules

ID: item-weather-clothes

Market price: 10 coins. Bulk: 1.

A cold- or wet-weather outfit, specified when bought. Bulk 1 even when worn over ordinary clothes. Enables plausible travel in its intended weather; grants no resistance, immunity or automatic survival.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
